item.title: Roger Waters Does Not Regret Trashing Ozzy Osbourne Following His Death
item.description: Roger Waters says he has no regrets about the critical comments he made about Ozzy Osbourne in the immediate aftermath of the metal legend’s death.

item.title: Jenny Lewis Roasts Sean Penn in Poem: "why wouldn't hollywood men/ date their daughter's friends"
item.description: Jenny Lewis woke up Saturday and chose violence, sharing a poem that roasts Sean Penn and the 34-year age-gap with girlfriend Valeria Nicova.

item.title: John Mayer Gives Tearful Eulogy, Performs "Ripple" at Bob Weir's Memorial
item.description: John Mayer delivered an emotional eulogy for his friend and mentor, Grateful Dead co-founder Bob Weir, during a public memorial in San Francisco.

item.title: SNL Spoofs Netflix's Stranger Things Universe
item.description: SNL spoofed Stranger Things' various offshoots with help from Finn Wolfhard, Gaten Matarazzo and Caleb McLaughlin.

item.title: SNL Mashes Together Harry Potter and Heated Rivalry as Heated Wizardly
item.description: The breakout success of HBO's gay hockey series Heated Rivalry inspired this week’s SNL to reimagine the upcoming Harry Potter reboot with a far sultrier premise.

item.title: Jon Stewart Addresses Possibility of Running for Office
item.description: Would Jon Stewart consider running for office? It’s a question The Daily Show host was recently asked during a post-show Q&A, which has since been posted to the show’s YouTube page.

item.title: Dolly Parton Day Declared for January 19th in Tennessee
item.description: The state of Tennessee has declared January 19th, 2026, as Dolly Parton Day.

item.title: Bruce Springsteen Denounces ICE's "Gestapo Tactics," Dedicates Performance to Renee Good
item.description: Bruce Springsteen delivered a forceful rebuke of the "Gestapo tactics against our fellow citizens" that he said are on display in Minneapolis at the direction of Donald Trump.

item.title: America's Oldest Dance Troupe Cancels Performance at Kennedy Center
item.description: The Martha Graham Dance Company had been scheduled to appear at the Kennedy Center as part of its centennial tour across the US.

item.title: Mickey Hart Eulogizes Bob Weir at His Memorial: "He Was a True Original"
item.description: Mickey Hart eulogized Bob Weir at a public memorial held in San Francisco on Saturday, remembering his late Grateful Dead bandmate as a true original.
